fusions.name: Left Then Right
fusions.desc: Strikes twice, left then right, each blow dealing 7 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Palm Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 6 open-palm strikes of force at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Extra Pair
fusions.desc: Conjures a spare pair of hands that fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking an enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ambidexterity
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 10% sooner.
